verdict.rationale: Muse's Goals tab and docs describe autonomous background operation - continuing tasks on schedule/events, monitoring, following up, and notifying users - which directly matches the story, and this is corroborated somewhat by independent commentary. However, hands-on community evidence shows the control plane can time out under stress/load, undermining reliability of persistent autonomous automations. missing for 10: independent verification of long-running reliability at scale, detail on how automation schedules/triggers are configured by users.
